buildCommand: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build

rewrites.comment: SPA fallback for client-side routes only. /api must be excluded: a catch-all rewrite answers API calls with index.html and HTTP 200, so a missing VITE_API_URL fails silently as an empty dataset instead of a 404. sw.js and the manifest are excluded for the same reason — rewriting the worker to index.html leaves the app with no offline shell.

headers.comment: Revalidate on every load. A cached service worker keeps serving the previous build's precache, so a deployment reaches nobody until it expires.
Content-hashed filenames: the bytes behind a URL never change.
